auditQuestion: Can public evidence connect Taylorville Memorial Hospital's prices, public-payer payment rules, cost-report economics, system affiliation, and clinical reimbursement logic without confusing price, payment, cost, and margin?

facilityIdentifiers.label: Price transparency EIN/file prefix
facilityIdentifiers.source: Memorial Health machine-readable standard charges file

evidenceRows.evidenceName: Taylorville Memorial Hospital standard charges CSV
evidenceRows.detail: Machine-readable hospital price file is mapped for Taylorville Memorial Hospital. The app can preview service examples from the CSV through the Price Transparency importer.
evidenceRows.proves: Publicly posted price signals such as gross charge, cash price, and payer negotiated-rate fields where parsed.
evidenceRows.doesNotProve: Actual payment, claim volume, patient responsibility, denials, Medicaid/Medicare reimbursement, or margin.

evidenceRows.evidenceName: Illinois HFS hospital rate sheets and provider-level payment data
evidenceRows.source: Illinois HFS hospital reimbursement and Transparency Law files
evidenceRows.detail: Match Taylorville by CMS ID, legal/provider name, county, and Memorial Health affiliation across HFS rate sheet and provider-payment files.
evidenceRows.proves: Published Medicaid hospital rate context and aggregate public payment flow where Taylorville or its legal/provider entity appears.
evidenceRows.doesNotProve: Claim-level allowed amount, managed-care contract terms, severity, coding, denials, or patient-specific payment.

evidenceRows.evidenceName: CMS HCRIS and Illinois Medicaid hospital cost reports
evidenceRows.source: CMS HCRIS cost reports and Illinois HFS hospital cost report archive
evidenceRows.detail: Map Taylorville's reporting identifiers to cost-report worksheets for revenue, expense, beds, utilization, wage, cost-to-charge, and margin signals.
evidenceRows.proves: Reported cost-report economics, utilization, and facility operating context.
evidenceRows.doesNotProve: Exact service-line profitability, real-time cash position, private payer profitability, or system subsidy flows.

evidenceRows.evidenceName: ED, observation, inpatient, transfer, LOS, outlier, HAC/POA, and readmission rule bridge
evidenceRows.source: Illinois HFS inpatient rules and CMS MS-DRG/IPPS rule files
evidenceRows.detail: Use test clinical scenarios to connect diagnosis/procedure coding, LOS, transfer status, outliers, and quality/payment-risk rules to the public price/payment/cost layers.
evidenceRows.proves: How rules can change expected reimbursement under a defined scenario.
evidenceRows.doesNotProve: Whether any real encounter was coded, billed, denied, or paid correctly without claim and medical-record evidence.

clinicalScenarios.name: ED visit discharged home
clinicalScenarios.logic: Outpatient ED level, labs, imaging, drug, and facility-charge logic.
clinicalScenarios.neededEvidence: CPT/HCPCS, revenue code, payer price rows, Medicaid outpatient rule, and volume/payment file.

clinicalScenarios.name: ED to observation
clinicalScenarios.logic: Observation status, hourly/packaged outpatient payment logic, ancillary services, and discharge disposition.
clinicalScenarios.neededEvidence: Observation code rows, outpatient reimbursement rules, price rows, and HFS/CMS payment benchmarks.

clinicalScenarios.name: ED to inpatient admission
clinicalScenarios.logic: Principal diagnosis, procedure coding, DRG/APR-DRG assignment, severity, LOS, and discharge status.
clinicalScenarios.neededEvidence: DRG/APR-DRG rule file, expected LOS, transfer/outlier rules, and payer payment source.

clinicalScenarios.name: Transfer to higher level of care
clinicalScenarios.logic: Critical Access Hospital access role, transfer status, short-stay logic, ambulance/ancillary questions, and downstream receiving-hospital payment.
clinicalScenarios.neededEvidence: Discharge status, transfer rule, cost report utilization, and regional access context.

clinicalScenarios.name: Hospital-acquired complication risk
clinicalScenarios.logic: POA/HAC status, infection or pressure-injury documentation, quality penalty exposure, avoidable LOS, and denial risk.
clinicalScenarios.neededEvidence: CMS HAC/POA/readmission rules, measure-level quality data, claims or medical-record validation.
